reason: An education plugin for querying selected Chinese K12 curriculum standards, checking listed characters, words, and recitation items, and maintaining local learner mastery progress with stated coverage limits.

summaries.zh: 用于查询中国义务教育课程标准中的部分可判定能力与字词篇目，并在本地记录和统计学习者掌握进度的教育插件。
summaries.en: An education plugin for querying selected decidable capabilities and listed items from China’s K12 curriculum standards while recording and summarizing learner mastery locally.

capabilities: Searches bundled K12 curriculum capability anchors and official item lists
Records learner mastery data in local profile files
Computes learner progress and next measurable items
Reports curriculum coverage and documented limitations
